task:
Write two complete pure JS ES modules. Return ONLY JSON object with keys "shapes" and "rain", each value source code string. No imports, no IO, no markdown. Compact code under 120 lines total.
shapes: export function morphTarget(i,t,seeds,out). seeds Float32Array has 4 values per particle: angle a in [0,2pi], angle b [0,2pi], radius fraction r [0,1], phase u [0,1]. Write out[0..2] no allocations per call. Cycle continuously through TORUS, SPHERE, HELIX, then torus every 30 seconds: each holds 6s then smoothstep blends over 4s. Torus radius1.3 tube .3*r; sphere radius1.45 with uniform direction from u and a; helix radius1.0 with y spanning -1.4..1.4 using u, 3 turns plus b and tube .16*r. All shapes y offset .35; slow rotation about y t*.12. Handle t=0. Deterministic, finite, no random.
rain: export function createRainState(random=Math.random), export function respawnRain(state,random=Math.random,initial=false), export function stepRain(state,dt,level,onImpact,random=Math.random). State fields x,z,y,velocity,wait,size. spawn chooses one random 20x20 lamp grid: x=(integer[0,19]-9.5)*.26,z=(integer[0,19]-9.5)*.17-.3, but clamp x to [-2.35,2.35], z to [-1.6,1.6] to land inside pool. y=4.43, velocity=0, wait=random()*2.8, size=.38+random()*.3. initial additionally randomize y between -1.8 and4.43. stepRain waits hidden; semi implicit gravity5.8; when hits level call onImpact(x,z) exactly once then respawn noninitial. Return boolean visible (false waiting or impact). dt nonnegative capped1/30. No errors for dt0. Randomize position,size,wait on EVERY respawn.
response: {"shapes":"export function morphTarget(i,t,seeds,out){const f=(x)=>x<0?0:x>1?1:x;const seg=30;const p=mod(t,seg);const s= Math.floor(p/6);const tp=(p%6)/6;const ts=1-((tp-0.5+0.5)/0.5);let a=seeds[i*4+0],b=seeds[i*4+1],r=seeds[i*4+2],u=seeds[i*4+3];let x,y,z;let rot=t*0.12;switch(s){case0:x=1.3*Math.cos(a);z=1.3*Math.sin(a);y=r*0.3*Math.cos(b);break;case1:x=1.45*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*u);z=1.45*Math.sin(2*Math.PI*u);y=r*0.3*Math.cos(b);break;case2:x=Math.cos(a);z=Math.sin(a);y=-1.4+2.8*u;break;}let ox=1.3*Math.cos(rot),oz=1.3*Math.sin(rot);out[0]=(x*ox-z*oz)*1.0;out[1]=(y+0.35)*1.0;out[2]=(x*oz+z*ox)*1.0;}function mod(a,b){return a-(b*Math.floor(a/b));}","rain":"export function createRainState(random=Math.random){return{xs:[],zs:[],ys:[],vs:[],ws:[],sz:[]};}export function respawnRain(s,random=Math.random,initial=false){const i=Math.floor(random()*400);const x=(Math.floor(random()*20)-9.5)*0.26;const z=(Math.floor(random()*20)-9.5)*0.17-0.3;const cx=Math.max(-2.35,Math.min(2.35,x));const cz=Math.max(-1.6,Math.min(1.6,z));s.xs[i]=cx;s.zs[i]=cz;s.ys[i]=initial?random()*6.23-1.8:4.43;s.vs[i]=0;s.ws[i]=random()*2.8;s.sz[i]=0.38+random()*0.3;return s;}export function stepRain(s,dt,level,onImpact,random=Math.random){dt=Math.min(dt,1/30);for(let i=0;i<s.xs.length;i++){if(s.ws[i]>0){s.ws[i]-=dt;continue;}if(s.ys[i]>level){s.vs[i]+=5.8*dt;s.ys[i]-=s.vs[i]*dt;if(s.ys[i]<=level){s.ys[i]=level;onImpact(s.xs[i],s.zs[i]);respawnRain(s,random,false);}continue;}return true;}"}
